amendments.aborted_calls_disposition: 82 calls preserved at results/aborted_qc_run/ for auditability, ledger sha256 01c641f8db8735df5c0da9cb697b49e43cfea0028cd4b91ff159a97a135cccf4. EXCLUDED from every confirmatory analysis; enforced by tests/test_no_aborted_data.py.
amendments.parameter: uniform max_tokens for all five model conditions
amendments.per_model_ceilings: EXPLICITLY REJECTED - would make the serving configuration non-uniform across the comparison and confound model identity with configuration
amendments.reason: 2048 was an implementation constant in the runner, not a frozen scientific parameter. Early QC found gemini-2.5-pro terminating with finish_reason=length on 15/28 calls (54%), producing truncated JSON, because it spends most of its budget on internal reasoning tokens (~0.13 chars/token vs ~4.5 for gpt-4o). This would have confounded model behaviour with an avoidable output-budget ceiling.
amendments.unchanged: corpora, prompts, model ids, repetition counts, estimands, tolerances, retry/exclusion rules, randomization seed and schedule, metric definitions

analysis_code_version.commit_requirement: Analysis code must be committed to the approved research repository, and its commit SHA recorded, before execution.
analysis_code_version.environment: research-recovery/env/requirements.lock.txt (53 pinned packages, verified from a clean venv) plus research-recovery/env/Dockerfile.
analysis_code_version.pinning: Analysis code is frozen by file hashes recorded in protocol_lock.json (analysis_code_set_hash).

confirmatory: Delta(A->B) per (pipeline, candidate, property) with hierarchical bootstrap CIs
tolerance sensitivity curves over the frozen sweep
P2 evidence-span and label correctness vs gold
confirmatory_vs_exploratory.labeling_requirement: Every result in the manuscript is labeled confirmatory, secondary/descriptive, or exploratory. Additions after the freeze are exploratory by definition, regardless of motivation.
secondary_descriptive: cross-pipeline comparison of whether conclusions generalize

concurrency.BLOCKER: The brief requested controlled asynchronous concurrency. the managed execution path does NOT permit concurrent calls; calls must be serialized with a minimum inter-call interval. This is an environment constraint, documented rather than worked around. It changes the execution SCHEDULE only, not the study design: randomized interleaving is preserved as a seeded permutation walked one call at a time.
concurrency.evidence: Confirmed operationally 2026-05-09: a 3s inter-call sleep still produced Bedrock 429s. The production client's 429 path uses 15/30/60s exponential backoff with jitter.
concurrency.raise_condition: Do not raise max_concurrency above 1 without written confirmation of a supported concurrency limit. Doing so risks 429 storms that would contaminate the latency and retry metrics the study measures.
concurrency.rpm_limit: UNKNOWN - no published per-Experience figure obtained; scheduler paces on inter-call interval instead

execution_environment.credential_handling: environment / standard credential chain only; never committed
execution_environment.proprietary_separation: No production prompt text, production source, internal URL, or credential is present. Enforced by tests/test_no_proprietary_content.py, which applies a stricter rule set under PUBLIC_RELEASE=1.
execution_environment.public_artifact_note: Execution-infrastructure identifiers were removed from this public artifact because they are not required to reproduce any reported analysis. 'managed_execution_path' denotes the managed execution environment the confirmatory runs were issued through.
execution_environment.rationale: Model access is confirmed for all five conditions in the Experience's catalog.

transport.mechanism: transport-helper binary (cmd/transport-helper in the service module) over line-delimited JSON
transport.payload_note: managed execution path rejects model_parameters on this endpoint; max_tokens sent top-level. Frozen decoding condition unchanged.
transport.reason: plain HTTPS clients are rejected by the managed execution path's transport layer; the production Go client succeeds with identical credentials and headers
transport.scope: execution infrastructure only - no experimental condition changed

framing.primary_claim: A model migration should be treated as a stochastic regression-testing problem: candidate behavior is evaluated relative to the incumbent's own output variability, separately for each pipeline property and application tolerance.
framing.prohibited_terminology_note: Safety language requires an independent application-level correctness criterion. Pipeline 2 supplies correctness for P2 properties ONLY; it does not license safety claims about Pipeline 1.
framing.secondary_claim: Migration compatibility is not a single property of two model names; it varies across pipeline, workload, output property, serving configuration, and tolerance.

permitted_use: the source of the repetition-budget and task-count simulations
historical_pilot_study.prohibition: Its results are NEVER merged into the new confirmatory grid, pooled with new runs, or used to compute confirmatory estimates.
historical_pilot_study.reproduction_status: 21 results exactly reproduced, 3 with 1e-6 float drift, 0 disagreements. See REPRODUCTION_REPORT.md.
historical_pilot_study.status: The original 8-profile, 5-model, 5-repetition, 200-run experiment is a REPRODUCED MOTIVATING / PILOT STUDY.

legacy_m6_artifact.authoritative_estimator: run-level hierarchical bootstrap (publication_run_level_bootstrap.py lineage), distinct-repetitions off-diagonal treatment

documented_discrepancy.boundary_difference: approximately 0.0005: pair-level hierarchical CI upper bound -0.10047 (outside the -0.10 margin, hence rejected) vs run-level CI upper bound -0.09536 (inside, hence inconclusive)
documented_discrepancy.cause: different estimators, not an error in either
documented_discrepancy.interpretation: A 0.0005 shift in one CI bound flips a headline category. This is itself evidence for the revision's move away from a single universal tolerance.

legacy_m6_artifact.prohibition: MUST NOT be used by any revised analysis or manuscript generation. All revised analysis uses ONE authoritative run-level estimator (the run-level hierarchical bootstrap).
legacy_m6_artifact.retention: Preserved for historical reproduction only. Regenerable byte-identically via research-recovery/sim/publication_m6_three_way.py (15 passing tests).

candidates.limitation: MUTABLE ALIAS - not a dated snapshot. Served weights may change during or between runs. Disclosed as a reproducibility limitation; the canonical returned model id is logged per call so any change is detectable after the fact.

model_conditions.canonical_model_map: protocol/canonical_model_map.json - probed live 2026-09-09; 3 of 5 ids are rewritten by the managed execution path
model_conditions.canonical_model_mismatch: If the canonical returned model id does not match the frozen condition, FLAG the run. Never silently accept it.
model_conditions.status: FROZEN - availability confirmed in the model catalog
model_conditions.substitution_policy: Do not request additional model access and do not substitute newer aliases unless a selected model becomes unavailable before execution. Any substitution is recorded with its date and the protocol is re-frozen.

pairwise_estimands.C_AB: mean over the R_A x R_B incumbent-candidate cross product
pairwise_estimands.W_A: incumbent self-agreement: mean over DISTINCT-repetition within-incumbent pairs (off-diagonal treatment)
pairwise_estimands.off_diagonal_requirement: MANDATORY. Within-model comparisons are formed only over distinct original repetitions. The self-inclusive variant is retained as a labeled diagnostic only. Recovery confirmed the self-inclusive estimator puts the point estimate outside its own 95% CI for 6 of 11 metrics.
pairwise_estimands.panel_average_status: SECONDARY / DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Computed via the same code path for comparability. Never the headline result.
pairwise_estimands.resampling_unit: two-level: task instance (cluster) with replacement, then repetition within task x model cell with replacement

P1.name: compound assessment pipeline (revised research version)
P1.prompt_policy: NEWLY AUTHORED RESEARCH-ONLY PROMPTS, releasable in full. No proprietary artifact is a dependency of this study.
P1.provenance: revised research version of the recovered original 4-call scaffold

P2.correctness_criterion: gold 3-way labels + gold char-indexed evidence spans + deterministic verbatim-grounding invariant
P2.dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 (download gated behind click-through Terms of Use acceptance)
P2.gold_leakage_prohibition: Gold labels and gold evidence spans are NEVER revealed to the model during inference. They are used only for post-hoc scoring.
P2.name: ContractNLI document -> evidence extraction -> reasoning -> structured classification
P2.sampling_rationale: 607 NDAs are each annotated against the same 17 hypotheses; sampling doc x hypothesis pairs would violate the cluster bootstrap's independence assumption.
P2.sampling_unit: DOCUMENT (NDA), not document x hypothesis pair

pricing.manifest: protocol/pricing_manifest.json, built immediately before execution from protocol/pricing_manifest.template.json
post_execution: record actual input/output token usage for every request
compute estimated cost from frozen prices
record actual provider-account spend where available

P2.verbatim_span_grounding_definition: Every cited evidence span must appear verbatim (exact substring, after documented whitespace normalization) in the source document. Deterministic; requires no gold annotation.

correctness_vs_behavior_decomposition.incumbent_error_subset: Pre-register the subset of P2 instances the incumbent gets WRONG. Behavioral agreement measured on that subset is agreement-on-errors and must be reported separately.

cells.changed_behavior_improved_correctness: behavioral regression test FAILS but the candidate is BETTER - the central case a naive regression oracle gets wrong
cells.preserved_behavior_preserved_error: behavior preserved INCLUDING an incumbent error - NOT a success; flag explicitly

dimensions: correctness_change (candidate accuracy minus incumbent accuracy, with CI)
joint_classification.reporting: Report the joint cell for every (candidate, property). Never report behavioral preservation for P2 without the paired correctness change.

correctness_vs_behavior_decomposition.requirement: MANDATORY for P2. The analysis MUST distinguish a candidate that changes behavior but IMPROVES correctness from one that PRESERVES incumbent behavior while preserving an incumbent ERROR.

primary_metrics.metric_module_pinning: Metric definitions are frozen by hashing the analysis code; see analysis_code_set_hash in protocol_lock.json.

P1.behavioral_metrics.justification: NO application-grounded tolerance exists for P1 behavioral agreement. Reported on sensitivity curves only; no headline equivalence verdict. This is a deliberate change from the original study.

P2.label_accuracy_vs_gold.justification: classification correctness against gold labels is directly interpretable; a 5-point accuracy drop is a material regression

P2.verbatim_span_grounding_rate.justification: a deterministic invariant; any measurable rate of ungrounded citations is a defect

property_tolerances.legacy_comparison_note: Retained ONLY to permit comparison with the original study. Not a primary tolerance.
property_tolerances.policy: PROPERTY-SPECIFIC. A universal +/-0.10 threshold is NOT the headline result.
property_tolerances.rationale: In the original data 7 of 11 metrics change verdict between margins 0.05 and 0.15, and incumbent self-agreement is as low as 0.052 (M2.recommendations) - a 0.10 tolerance exceeds the entire signal for some properties.
property_tolerances.tolerance_setting_rule: Each property's tolerance is declared in advance with a written justification. Where no application-grounded justification exists, the property is reported on the sensitivity curve only and carries NO headline verdict.

public_api_replication.purpose: test whether the major qualitative findings reproduce outside the managed execution path; a robustness check, not a second confirmatory study
public_api_replication.scope: ~10 P1 tasks and ~10 P2 tasks through personal/public provider APIs
public_api_replication.timing: ONLY after the primary managed-execution-path experiment is complete. No personal API spend before then.

public_research_prompts.release: All eight prompts released in full with the paper.
public_research_prompts.verbatim_reuse_check: PASS - 6-gram shingle comparison against the historical production prompt found a single shared generic 6-gram ('no prose outside the json'). Comparison ran outside this repository; only the verdict is recorded. See prompts/pipeline1/VERBATIM_REUSE_CHECK.md.

randomization_procedure.implementation: A seeded permutation of the full (pipeline, task, model, repetition) tuple list, generated and hashed BEFORE execution.
randomization_procedure.order_effect_check: Pre-registered: regress each primary metric on execution_order_index; report as a diagnostic.
randomization_procedure.rationale: Reduces confounding from transient provider load and time-of-day effects; also spreads slow conditions across the run.
randomization_procedure.recorded_per_call: execution_order_index and wall_clock_timestamp, enabling post-hoc tests for order and time effects.
randomization_procedure.scheme: Execution is randomized/interleaved across model, task, and repetition. Model-major execution is PROHIBITED.

repetition_counts.justification: REPETITION_BUDGET_ANALYSIS.md: R_A=8 is the point of diminishing returns (last step with increasing marginal return, -4.86%); R=10/12 add ~80% incumbent cost for 4.7pp and one extra resolved cell. Simulation is a lower bound (cannot show diversity benefit of genuinely new generations).

exclusion_criteria: transport failure after exhausting the frozen retry budget
canonical returned model ID does not match the requested condition
prompt context hash mismatch against the frozen prompt
retry_and_exclusion_rules.metric_eligibility: Per-metric eligibility filtering is explicit and per-property. Analysis code must NOT assume a uniform panel: in the original data eligible cross pairs ranged 1767-2000 and within pairs 358-400 by metric.
retry_and_exclusion_rules.no_post_hoc_exclusion: No run may be excluded after seeing its metric values. Exclusions are determined by the frozen criteria above only.
retry_and_exclusion_rules.retry_policy: Frozen from the original harness: retries recorded per call with retry_count and retry_events. Retry limits and backoff are frozen at execution-config level and hashed.
retry_and_exclusion_rules.run_acceptance: A run is ACCEPTED if all pipeline calls returned and the run record validates. Schema violations and parse failures are DATA, not exclusion criteria - they are reported as compliance metrics.

semantic_matching.purpose_note: The purpose is to establish whether conclusions depend on the matching implementation, NOT to select a favorable configuration. All variants are reported.
semantic_matching.second_representation: REQUIRED: a second reasonable embedding model, frozen before execution, to test whether qualitative conclusions depend on the matching implementation.
semantic_matching.threshold_free_aggregate: REQUIRED where computationally feasible: a threshold-free aggregate (e.g. mean maximum cosine) reported alongside the thresholded metric.

P1.guarantee: all axis signatures distinct; zero primary/stress overlap; no email, URL, or company string

P2.gold_policy: gold_label and gold_spans stored for SCORING ONLY; inference_view() strips them; enforced by tests/test_corpora.py
P2.guarantee: one instance per document; zero primary/stress document overlap; gold labels balanced
P2.status: BUILT AND FROZEN from real ContractNLI (official release, CC BY 4.0)

task_corpora.stress_set_rule: Frozen in advance, analysed and reported separately, NEVER merged into the primary sample and NEVER added because a primary result is inconclusive.

task_counts.justification: TASK_COUNT_SENSITIVITY.md: 60 is the knee of the 1/sqrt(T) curve (8->60 cuts CI width 63.7%). Extrapolated from only 8 distinct profiles; absolute widths optimistic; NOT a power calculation.
task_counts.stress_set_rule: The stress/robustness set is defined and frozen IN ADVANCE, analysed SEPARATELY, and reported separately. It is NEVER merged into the primary sample. It must NOT be added because a primary result is inconclusive.

tolerance_sensitivity_ranges.conclusion_requirement: The main conclusion must survive changes in threshold. Any conclusion that holds only at one tolerance must be reported as tolerance-conditional.
required_outputs: tolerance sensitivity curve per property per candidate
the tolerance at which each verdict flips
